name: Washington
status_why: Enhanced Voting answered scripts; 20261103 is posted.
system: Enhanced Voting results platform (results.votewa.gov/results/public/washington), the Secretary of State's site since 2026; the old results.vote.wa.gov sends readers there

results_page.label: Washington Secretary of State: election results

feeds.address: https://results.votewa.gov/results/public/api/elections/washington/<yyyymmdd> (election record: isOfficialResults, lastUpdated, asOf, contest groups, parties, publicReportCategories naming the 'All Results Excel' blob); the workbook at https://results.votewa.gov/cdn/results/<blobName>
feeds.updates: counties post about 8:15 p.m., then usually once a day each business day until certification (Nov 24, 2026 per the record's own message)

feeds.address: the All Results Excel: 'Summary Results' sheet (statewide totals by contest and candidate) and 'Precinct Results' sheet (by county, first column the county)
feeds.note: No U.S. Senate race in Washington in 2026. The Enhanced Voting JSON for ballot items was not traced; the workbook is what the kit reads.

races_in_feed: Congress, legislature, judges, statewide measures; county and local contests are each county's (the statewide list covers them, but results are on county sites)
local: Yes for local results: 39 counties; King (kingcounty.gov/elections), Pierce, Snohomish, Spokane
how_counted: Washington votes by mail. Counties post about 8:15 p.m. Pacific, then usually once each business day until certification.
count_order: All mail; ordered by ballot arrival; counties publish ballots left to count daily.
vote_types: No split: all-mail state; the count is ordered by ballot arrival (postmarked by Election Day). Counties publish a daily ballots-left-to-count figure.

rules.note: The two who advanced from the Aug 4 primary.

certify.rule: As soon as every county's returns are in, but not later than the 30th day after the election (Wash. Rev. Code 29A.60.250).
certify.local_rule: Counties certify 21 days after the election (29A.60.190).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_plan: Poll the 20261103 election record every few minutes after 8 p.m. Pacific; when lastUpdated changes, fetch the All Results Excel it names (and, if a later scout finds the ballot-item JSON, that instead). Repeat daily until certification on Nov 24. The same workbook carries legislative, judicial and county-level rows; the counties' own sites for city and school results.
